description: Korean annual leave use promotion schedule (연차 사용촉진, 근로기준법 제61조): annual leave (①) = written prompt within 10 days from 6 months before the period ends, worker replies within 10 days, employer designates dates in writing by 2 months before; first-year monthly leave (②) = prompt within 10 days from 3 months before (leave arising later: 5 days from 1 month before), designation by 1 month before (later leave: 10 days before). Only when every step is done in writing on time does the employer owe no pay for unused leave. Not applicable under 5 employees.

kind.description: annual = leave of workers with 1+ year; firstYear = monthly leave in the first year

periodEnd.description: Last day the leave can be used (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. 2027-12-31 for a fiscal-year system
